`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or any tests.

The 404 body is built with `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`, following the project's problem+json convention. The `detail` field includes the requested id. I also added the `from .errors import problem` import.

Before this change, a missing invoice made the handler call `.__dict__` on `None`, which raised an `AttributeError` and returned a 500.

I didn't save anything new to memory. The problem+json convention was already recorded, and nothing else durable came up.
